acceptanceCriteria: Repository, Repository Protocol, Runtime, Agents, and Human Authority are visually and conceptually distinct in the 3D scene.
The lifecycle inspect -> attach -> start -> preflight -> checkpoint -> verify -> finish -> archive -> close is represented and explorable without reading the README.
GREEN verification with PENDING human decision and RED fail-closed behavior are both demonstrated; UNKNOWN never appears as approval.
A guided tour exists and a new user can understand the core architecture in approximately 30 seconds.
npm ci, lint, typecheck, unit tests, Playwright tests, and production build all succeed.
The site deploys to GitHub Pages at https://xinglun.github.io/ai-cockpit-explorer/ and the README links to it.
goal: Ship a v0.1 greybox MVP interactive 3D architecture explorer (Next.js App Router + React Three Fiber, static export) deployed to GitHub Pages, so a first-time visitor understands AI Cockpit's architecture, lifecycle, and governance boundaries in about 30 seconds.
intent: Build an interactive real-time 3D architecture experience that helps a first-time visitor understand AI Cockpit's structure and governance model quickly.
